input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves Admin, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include admin protected rest, authentication rest, person rest. Core business data revolves around Authority, User. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a Admin, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a Admin, I want to manage admin protected rest operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a Admin, I want to manage authentication rest operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a Admin, I want to manage person rest operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
